name: Philis
source: The succubus teacher in charge of the [url=/c94631]protagonist's[/url] class who gives off an aura of motherhood. She is very gentle and mild-mannered, but when she sees little boys her succubus instincts burst in combination with maternal instincts. She is in charge of monitoring the protagonist but she is having a hard time since she has not had to deal with men much. Her magic power is the second highest in the school to the [url=/c94659]director[/url]. It seems she has firm grasp of summoning skills and can handle wife-level lewd magic.
